rules.accepted_credit_types: ACCME-accredited programs qualifying for AMA PRA Category 1; AAFP prescribed credit; AOA Category 1-A; programs required to maintain national board certification (not self-claimed). No limit on online hours; topics self-selected
rules.new_licensee_rule: CME requirement starts immediately upon initial licensure.
rules.alternatives: Board waiver for health or undue hardship (petition at least 3 months before expiry); if denied, renew once and document 60 hours by end of next period. Military exemption available.
rules.audit_note: Do not submit documentation unless requested; keep CME records at least 4 years.
rules.notes: One board for MDs and DOs. Board Rule 1.29 (substance use disorder CE) was proposed for repeal under SB 26-138 at an Aug 27, 2026 hearing; outcome not confirmed, so not listed as a topic.
